mentions.name: RandomHowl
mentions.description: A randomizer for the game Death Howl that adds variety to custom mode for players who have finished challenge runs and want fresh ways to replay.
mentions.problem: After doing a few challenge runs in Death Howl, the author wanted more out of the game's custom mode.
